name: fixbench: which kind of fix delays the policy least, at equal safety (offline, counterfactual)
registered: 2026-10-24 ~19:00 EDT, before any bench branch was run
question: fixcf showed a G-CEM fix delays the grasp 1.36 chunks vs 0.41 chunk of motion removed (amplification): the policy detours after a deviation. Is the detour caused by the fix leaving the policy's own distribution? Then SELECTION among the policy's own samples (in-distribution, same certificate) should delay less. G-steer is measured on the same yardstick.
cases: the 150 fixcf decisions (eval/fix_counterfactual.py cases; seed 20261025): approach decisions where the 3x filter intervened, paired_cbfg3m_stl, no neighbour topple in the logged episode
harness: exactly fixcf: exact saved state d, 2-frame history rebuilt by replaying chunk d-1, the run's execution noise (scale 2), one first chunk per branch, then the policy alone for up to 30 chunks with the same denoising seed in every branch

branches.job ARMS=sel: nominal (policy's own chunk), gcem (the logged deployed fix), sel (16 fresh policy samples from the same history, seed 20261025+7+1000e+d; certified with the 3x filter's certificate: OIL+ENS, 64 fresh futures per model, h >= min(h_hold, 2), o <= O_MAX; the certified sample with the lowest opt2 change cost vs the policy's plan; none -> hold if certified, else best (h, -o), as opt2.finish), resample (control: sample 0, uncertified)
branches.job ARMS=steer: nominal, steer (G-steer recomputed at d with cbfgst3m's search and certificate, regardless of the trigger)

measures: as fixcf: grasp (gripper < 55), extract, neighbour topple (>= 45 deg); not grasped within 30 = 31
primary: delay(arm) = grasp(arm) - grasp(nominal, same job) on cases where neither branch toppled. PRIMARY: mean of delay(sel) - delay(gcem), paired over cases where neither of the four branches' relevant pairs toppled (sel/nominal and gcem/nominal); bootstrap (10000, seed 20261027) one-sided 95% upper bound < 0 AND topple non-inferiority: one-sided 95% upper bound of (topple(sel) - topple(gcem)) over all cases <= +3 pp -> PASS ('in-distribution fixes cost less time'). Otherwise FAIL.
secondary: mean delay of gcem, sel, resample (each with a 90% bootstrap interval); resample answers: does ANY different policy sample cost time? (if resample ~ gcem, the detour is about deviating at all, not about leaving the distribution)
sel kinds (certified / fallback hold / fallback best) and number certified of 16
steer: mean delay and steer - gcem (paired across jobs, each relative to its own nominal); topples
reproduction: nominal and gcem branches identical to fixcf rows (same harness, same cluster)
run: Fir, cluster/fixbench.sbatch: ARMS=sel 15 tasks x 10 cases, ARMS=steer 10 tasks x 15 cases; smoke 1 case each first (not analysed separately; it is case 0 of shard 0 and is kept)
next_if_pass: policy-guided sampling (barrier-gradient guidance inside the diffusion denoising) as the next fix arm on this bench, then a closed-loop test
